title: Transforming Integer Grids to Spatial Intuition: Perception, Not Planning, Governs ARC-AGI-3
title_zh: 先路由，后观察：通过将路由策略与动作空间分离使视觉智能体实现科学推理

paragraphs.en: Autonomous skill acquisition under epistemic uncertainty represents a foundational benchmark for artificial general intelligence. When human players encounter an unfamiliar interactive environment, they do not read procedural manuals—they visually parse the scene within hundreds of milliseconds, effortlessly abstracting embodiment, spatial boundaries, and functional affordances from core-knowledge visual priors ( Spelke and Kinzler 2007 ) . The ARC-AGI-3 benchmark ( ARC Prize Foundation 2026b ) formalizes this capability by evaluating agents across uninstructed, sequential game environments using Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE)—a metric that penalizes superfluous exploratory actions quadratically ( Chollet 2019 ) . Under the strict rules of the official offline track, candidate agents must resolve undisclosed games within a nine-hour wall-clock limit on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU without external network connectivity, precluding both human intervention and unconstrained exploratory rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 在认知不确定性下的自主技能习得是通用人工智能的一项基础性基准。 当人类玩家遇到一个陌生的交互环境时，他们并不阅读操作手册——他们会在数百毫秒内对场景进行视觉解析，借助核心知识的视觉先验（Spelke and Kinzler 2007）毫不费力地抽象出身体形态、空间边界和功能性可供性。 ARC-AGI-3 基准（ARC Prize Foundation 2026b）通过在无指令的序列化游戏环境中评估智能体来形式化这一能力，其采用的相对人类动作效率（RHAE）指标会对多余探索动作进行二次方惩罚（Chollet 2019）。 在官方离线赛道的严格规则下，候选智能体必须在单块 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU 上于九小时墙钟时限内解决未公开的游戏，且不允许外部网络连接，从而排除了人工干预和无约束的探索式推演。

paragraphs.en: However, deploying language and vision-language reasoning models in this interactive regime reveals a severe representational bottleneck. While modern reasoning backbones demonstrate strong symbolic deduction when provided with clean declarative state descriptions, their execution collapses when exposed to raw 64 × 64 64{\times}64 integer coordinate matrices. In preliminary experiments (Section 3 ), a state-of-the-art frontier model expended over 200–300 exploratory actions navigating an elementary maze serialized as raw tokens, exhausting its action budget and failing the task. In stark contrast, providing the identical model with an aligned visual rendering and geometric breakdown reduced required actions to 6–12, surpassing human baselines. This divergence demonstrates that policy deduction is rarely the primary failure mode; rather, unparsed token grids systematically destroy topological adjacency, forcing autoregressive attention to reconstruct basic spatial relations at prohibitive token and action costs.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在这种交互式模式下部署语言与视觉-语言推理模型，暴露出一个严重的表征瓶颈。 尽管现代推理骨干网络在获得干净的状态描述时能展现出强大的符号演绎能力，但当面对原始的 64 × 64 64{\times}64 整数坐标矩阵时，其执行能力便会崩溃。 在初步实验（第 3 节）中，一个最先进的前沿模型在导航一个以原始 token 序列化的基础迷宫时，消耗了超过 200–300 次探索动作，耗尽了其动作预算并未能完成任务。 与之形成鲜明对比的是，为同一模型提供对齐的视觉渲染和几何分解后，所需动作降至 6–12 次，超越了人类基线。 这一差异表明，策略推演很少是主要的失败模式；相反，未经解析的 token 网格系统性地破坏了拓扑邻接关系，迫使自回归注意力以高昂的 token 和动作成本去重建基本的空间关系。

paragraphs.en: To resolve this fundamental bottleneck, we conduct extensive empirical ablations and establish two central insights:
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这一根本性瓶颈，我们进行了大量的实证消融实验，并得出两个核心洞察：

paragraphs.en: Perceptual Misinduction —Serializing spatial environments as discrete token matrices causes reasoning models to induce flawed topological models, triggering catastrophic quadratic action penalties during early exploratory steps.
paragraphs.zh: 知觉性误归纳——将空间环境序列化为离散的令牌矩阵，会导致推理模型归纳出有缺陷的拓扑模型，并在早期探索步骤中触发灾难性的二次方动作惩罚。

paragraphs.en: The Measured–Guessed Rule —Geometric invariants, including lattice reachability, spatial enclosures, midpoint tethers, and dihedral symmetries under D 4 × ℤ + D_{4}\times\mathbb{Z}^{+} , can be computed deterministically in 𝒪 ⁡ ( H ​ W ) \mathcal{O}(HW) host code without training, whereas high-level affordance roles remain latent under partial observability and must be framed as probabilistic hypotheses paired with unit-action falsification probes.
paragraphs.zh: 「测量—猜测」规则——几何不变量（包括格点可达性、空间包围、中点系绳，以及 D 4 × ℤ + D_{4}\times\mathbb{Z}^{+} 下的二面角对称性）可以在 𝒪 ⁡ ( H W ) \mathcal{O}(HW) 的宿主代码中无需训练地确定性计算，而高层可供性角色在部分可观测性下仍保持隐式，必须被构造为与单位动作证伪探针相配对的概率假设。

paragraphs.en: Building on these insights, we introduce Sarbloh , an autonomous open-weight agent architecture engineered around a deterministic perception engine and speculative code execution. Rather than delegating visual scene decomposition to costly neural inference, our host-side perception engine executes in approximately 35 ms per frame on a single CPU core, transforming raw environment states into three synchronized modalities: an object-centric symbolic state with temporal bipartite identity tracking, a structured geometric briefing governed by the Measured–Guessed Rule, and an affordance-annotated spatial map. The agent acts exclusively through an embedded IPython execution kernel, synthesizing algorithmic state models and dispatching multi-step trajectories via a speculative execution primitive ( await play() ) that monitors environment invariants and halts immediately upon sensory prediction discrepancies.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些洞察，我们提出 Sarbloh，一种自主的开源权重智能体架构，其设计围绕确定性感知引擎与投机性代码执行构建。 我们的宿主侧感知引擎并不将视觉场景分解委托给昂贵的神经推理，而是在单个 CPU 核心上每帧约 35 毫秒内完成执行，将原始环境状态转换为三种同步的模态：具有时序二部身份追踪的以对象为中心的符号状态、由“测量—猜测规则”约束的结构化几何简报，以及带可供性标注的空间地图。 该智能体完全通过内嵌的 IPython 执行内核进行行动，合成算法化状态模型，并通过投机执行原语（await play()）分发多步轨迹，该原语监控环境不变量，并在感知预测出现偏差时立即停止。

paragraphs.en: Evaluated under identical offline hardware constraints, Sarbloh achieves state-of-the-art action efficiency across both public and undisclosed environments. Across the 25 public ARC-AGI-3 game environments, Sarbloh resolves 143 of 183 levels in 8.2 hours, discovering distinct solutions significantly faster than the first Milestone winner on identical Kaggle hardware and model weights. On the official held-out Kaggle evaluation suite, Sarbloh advanced from an initial baseline of 0.27 to a verified score of 16.53 —a 13.7 × \times efficiency improvement over the first Milestone winner.
paragraphs.zh: 在完全相同的离线硬件约束下评估，Sarbloh 在公开与未公开环境中均实现了最先进的动作效率。 在 25 个公开的 ARC-AGI-3 游戏环境中，Sarbloh 在 8.2 小时内解决了 183 个关卡中的 143 个，在相同的 Kaggle 硬件与模型权重下，其发现不同解法的速度显著快于首届 Milestone 优胜者。 在官方保留的 Kaggle 评估套件上，Sarbloh 从 0.27 的初始基线提升到经核实的 16.53 分——相比首届 Milestone 优胜者实现了 13.7 × \times 的效率提升。

paragraphs.en: The primary contributions of this work are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 本工作的主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We identify and analyze the visual grounding bottleneck in interactive ARC-AGI-3 , formalizing the Perceptual Misinduction failure mode and empirically deriving The Measured–Guessed Rule through controlled representation ablations (§ 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在交互式 ARC-AGI-3 中识别并分析了视觉定位瓶颈，形式化定义了「感知误归纳」（Perceptual Misinduction）失败模式，并通过受控表征消融实验实证推导出「测量—猜测规则」（The Measured–Guessed Rule）（§ 3）。

paragraphs.en: We propose Sarbloh , an autonomous agent featuring a zero-parameter, 𝒪 ⁡ ( H ​ W ) \mathcal{O}(HW) deterministic perception engine, a speculative code-as-action planning runtime, and a monotonic append-only KV-cache architecture sustaining a 98.4% prefix-cache hit rate (§ 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Sarbloh，一个自主智能体，它具有零参数、𝒪 ⁡ ( H ​ W ) \mathcal{O}(HW) 的确定性感知引擎、一个投机式代码即动作（code-as-action）规划运行时，以及一个维持 98.4% 前缀缓存命中率的单调只增 KV 缓存架构（§ 4）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Sarbloh across public and official hidden benchmarks , demonstrating a 13.7 × \times score gain over the first Milestone winner, providing hardware-matched comparative telemetry, and detailing the failure modes that govern interactive open-weight reasoning (§ 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在公开基准测试和官方隐藏基准测试上对 Sarbloh 进行了评估，结果表明其分数相比首届 Milestone 冠军提升了 13.7 × \times 倍，提供了硬件匹配的可对比遥测数据，并详细分析了支配交互式开源权重推理的失败模式（§ 5 ）。

paragraphs.en: Before designing the agent architecture, we conducted controlled empirical ablations to isolate where autoregressive reasoning models expend their exploratory action allocations during interactive problem solving.
paragraphs.zh: 在设计智能体架构之前，我们进行了受控的实证消融实验，以分离自回归推理模型在交互式问题解决过程中将探索性动作分配消耗在哪些方面。

paragraphs.en: We evaluated an identical frontier reasoning model (Gemini 3.1 Pro via commercial API, greedy decoding at temperature T = 0 T=0 , evaluated in a single diagnostic trial n = 1 n=1 on 12 October 2026) on the opening level of the official environment ls20 , holding the prompt template and environment state transitions strictly invariant while altering only the input observation representation (Figure 2 ). While an exploratory single-trial diagnostic is inherently limited in statistical variance, its primary objective was not distribution estimation, but rather isolating the catastrophic representational failure mode that occurs before any downstream policy search begins. When provided with the environment serialized as a raw 64 × 64 64{\times}64 integer matrix, the model expended between 200 and 300 actions repeatedly colliding with invisible topological boundaries, exhausting the permissible budget without reaching the goal state. Recovering reachability and spatial adjacency from 4,096 serialized integers imposes an associative retrieval burden that multi-head attention mechanisms execute unreliably ( Rahmanzadehgervi et al. 2024 ) . Supplying a rendered raster image of identical board state reduced the required exploration by an order of magnitude to 12–24 actions. Augmenting this visual input with an explicit structural decomposition of terrain, HUD gauges, and color parity further consolidated the trajectory to 12 actions. Finally, enabling the model to express search routines as executable Python scripts within a sandboxed runtime cleared the level in 6 actions, achieving super-human efficiency relative to the human baseline of approximately 10 actions. Critically, over 90% of the aggregate efficiency gain resulted from structuring the perceptual representation rather than extending inference-time chain-of-thought deliberation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个相同的前沿推理模型上进行了评估（通过商业 API 调用的 Gemini 3.1 Pro，采用温度 T = 0 T=0 的贪心解码，于 2026 年 10 月 12 日在单次诊断试验 n = 1 n=1 中评估），环境为官方环境 ls20 的开局关卡，在仅改变输入观测表示（图 2）的同时，严格保持提示模板和环境状态转移不变。 尽管探索性的单次试验诊断在统计方差上存在固有局限，其主要目标并非分布估计，而是隔离在任何下游策略搜索开始之前就会出现的灾难性表示失效模式。 当环境以原始的 64 × 64 64{\times}64 整数矩阵序列化形式提供时，该模型在 200 到 300 次动作之间反复与不可见的拓扑边界碰撞，耗尽了允许的预算而未能到达目标状态。 从 4,096 个序列化整数中恢复可达性与空间邻接关系，给多头注意力机制带来了难以可靠执行的关联检索负担（Rahmanzadehgervi 等人，2024）。 提供相同棋盘状态的渲染光栅图像后，所需探索减少了一个数量级，降至 12–24 次动作。 在这一视觉输入基础上，进一步增加对地形、HUD 仪表和颜色奇偶性的显式结构分解，将轨迹进一步巩固到 12 次动作。 最后，使智能体能够在沙箱运行时内以可执行的 Python 脚本表达搜索例程后，该智能体以 6 次动作通关，相对于人类基线的约 10 次动作，达到了超越人类的效率。 至关重要的是，总体效率提升中超过 90% 来自于对感知表示的结构化组织，而非扩展推理时的思维链 deliberation。

paragraphs.en: To decouple strategic reasoning capacity from state representation errors, we evaluated the model on a complex ls20 level under two informational regimes: visual screenshots alone, and screenshots accompanied by an “oracle briefing” explicitly detailing sprite roles, mechanics, and geometric dependencies. Without the briefing, the agent squandered its full action budget interacting with inert visual artifacts. With the briefing, the model formulated an optimal plan and cleared the level in 6 actions. The underlying planning mechanism was functionally capable from the outset, and its operational failure was induced entirely by erroneous state perception.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将战略推理能力与状态表征误差解耦，我们在一个复杂的 ls20 关卡上，在两种信息条件下对模型进行了评估：仅视觉截图，以及截图附带一份明确详述精灵角色、机制与几何依赖关系的「神谕简报」。 没有简报时，智能体把全部动作预算都浪费在与无实际作用的视觉元素交互上。 有了简报后，模型制定出最优方案，仅用 6 个动作就通关了该关卡。 底层规划机制从一开始就在功能上是完备的，其运行失败完全由错误的状态感知所致。

paragraphs.en: While transmitting only modified grid coordinates minimizes prompt token consumption, it systematically masks non-local causal couplings. In ARC-AGI-3 environments, local actuation regularly triggers distant visual consequences, such as stepping onto an activation switch in ls20 updating a status icon across the display. Under sparse delta streams, the agent fails to observe this distributed covariance and falsely infers that its action was non-functional. Consequently, preserving full-frame topological awareness remains mandatory.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然只传输发生变化的网格坐标能最小化提示词 token 的消耗，但这会系统性地掩盖非局部的因果耦合。 在 ARC-AGI-3 环境中，局部动作常常会触发远处的视觉后果，例如在 ls20 中踩上激活开关会导致整个显示屏上的状态图标更新。 在稀疏的增量数据流下，智能体无法观察到这种分布式协变，并错误地推断其动作没有产生任何效果。 因此，保留全画幅的拓扑感知仍然是必须的。

paragraphs.en: Because oracle briefings cannot exist for undisclosed evaluation environments, the agent must extract its own representations. ARC-AGI-3 is grounded in human core knowledge priors ( Spelke and Kinzler 2007 ) , which are intrinsically geometric and topological. Properties such as lattice connectivity, bounding enclosures, midpoint tethers, and dihedral symmetries can be computed deterministically from grid coordinates without learned parameters. Conversely, operational affordances, such as agent embodiment and win conditions, remain latent until verified through physical interaction. Conflating these two epistemic categories causes models to treat transient guesses as ground truth, triggering catastrophic action loops.
paragraphs.zh: 由于未公开的评测环境不可能存在先知式简报，智能体必须自行构建其表征。 ARC-AGI-3 根植于人类核心知识先验（Spelke and Kinzler 2007），这些先验本质上是几何和拓扑性质的。 格子连通性、边界围合、中点系带和二面体对称性等属性可以从网格坐标中确定性地计算出来，而无需学习参数。 相反，操作性可供性（如智能体的具身形式和获胜条件）在通过物理交互验证之前始终是潜在的。 将这两类认识范畴混为一谈会导致模型把临时猜测当作真值，从而引发灾难性的行动循环。

paragraphs.en: Our initial baseline, adapting the open harness of Prime Agent ( Karten et al. 2026 ) , scored between 0.00 and 0.27 on the hidden evaluation set, initiating over 350 voluntary level restarts across ten games without once resolving a goal state. The reasoning model was proficient at code synthesis, yet fundamentally incapable of spatial scene parsing. This section formalizes the governing principle of representation (Section 4.1 ), the deterministic perception engine that realizes it (Section 4.2 ), the unified programmatic action interface (Section 4.3 ), and the prefix-cached serving loop that fits within single-GPU hardware bounds (Section 4.4 ). Figure 3 illustrates an end-to-end execution turn of the complete architecture.

paragraphs.en: The Role Ledger scored every object against eight game roles and printed each top guess with its evidence and the cheapest action that would confirm or refute it (20/28, about 380 tokens). The Fused Briefing added the relations that code computes exactly—reachability, enclosure, midpoint tethers, shape equivalence—as a separate tier above the guesses (25/28, about 370 tokens). It scored 8.3 × 8.3\times the Legacy Encoder with 89% fewer tokens. paragraphs.en: We subsequently evaluated cross-distribution generalization across 23 held-out official game environments excluded during engine prototyping. Grid reconstruction achieved 100% cell accuracy across all games, and morphological segmentation reliably preserved entity boundaries and spatial tracking without degradation. Whereas topological and geometric invariants hold unconditionally by mathematical construction, high-level semantic roles (such as agent embodiment or interactive affordances) inherently possess visual ambiguity prior to actuation. Consequently, the engine treats role labels not as brittle, hardcoded classifications, but as provisional inductive hypotheses paired with minimal unit-action verification probes. This decoupling ensures that any transient misclassification of initial sprite affordances is immediately resolved upon the first interaction step, while preserving complete coordinate, topological, and geometric stability across the entire scene.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，我们评估了跨分布泛化能力，测试对象为 23 个在引擎原型设计阶段被排除在外的保留官方游戏环境。 网格重构在所有游戏中实现了 100% 的单元格准确率，且形态学分割可靠地保留了实体边界与空间跟踪，未出现性能退化。 虽然拓扑不变量和几何不变量凭借其数学构造可以无条件成立，但高层语义角色（如智能体化身或交互可供性）在执行动作之前天然具有视觉模糊性。 因此，该引擎并不将角色标签视为脆弱的硬编码分类，而是将其视为临时性的归纳假设，并配以最小化的单元动作验证探针。 这种解耦确保了对初始精灵可供性的任何瞬态误分类都能在第一个交互步骤立即得到解决，同时在整个场景中保持完整的坐标、拓扑与几何稳定性。

paragraphs.en: State what can be measured as fact; state what must be inferred as a guess that carries a one-action test. We term this the Measured–Guessed Rule . A measured relation is computed from the grid by code with no learned parameters, so it is true by construction and the model need not check it. A role cannot be read from one frame, and a role stated as fact plants perceptual misinduction —a wrong belief about what an object is or does—that the model then spends actions on. A role stated as a guess with a test costs at most one action to settle, and under RHAE, where cost grows with the square of the action count, that cap is the point.
paragraphs.zh: 把能测量到的内容作为事实陈述；把必须推断的内容作为带有一次行动检验的猜测陈述。 我们将其称为测量—猜测规则。 测量到的关系由代码直接从网格计算得出，不含任何学习参数，因此它在构造上即为真，模型无需对其进行检验。 角色无法从单帧中读取，而作为事实陈述的角色会埋下知觉性误归纳——即关于某物体是什么或做什么的错误信念——模型随后会为此耗费行动。 作为带有检验的猜测陈述的角色，最多只需一次行动即可确定；而在行动成本随行动次数平方增长的RHAE中，这一上限正是关键所在。

paragraphs.en: The perception engine identifies the background canvas as the modal color index across the frame and extracts all remaining four-connected monochromatic regions as discrete entities. Because standard morphological segmentation re-indexes components in raster reading order at every step, dynamic entities moving across the board would continually swap indices, causing synthesized Python scripts to silently reference incorrect objects. To maintain temporal consistency, Sarbloh anchors object identifiers on the initial frame of each level and preserves identity across transitions through a multi-stage bipartite matching algorithm. This procedure runs five passes in order: objects unchanged in colour, shape and place; objects moved with the same colour and shape (the nearest is taken); objects recoloured in the same shape and place; objects reshaped in the same colour (the one sharing most cells is taken); and, last, fresh identifiers for objects that match nothing (Algorithm 1 , stage 1). As a result, each identifier reliably tracks the same physical entity throughout an entire level. In addition to the tracked object table, the spatial state is serialized as an alphanumeric coordinate grid and paired with a differential change ledger detailing the bounding box and cell count modified by each transition. Furthermore, environmental modifications occurring within the three-cell peripheral screen boundary are isolated as heads-up display telemetry, preventing passive counter decrements or timer ticks from being misinterpreted as operational task progress.
paragraphs.zh: 感知引擎将背景画布识别为整帧中的众数颜色索引，并把其余所有四连通单色区域提取为离散实体。 由于标准的形态学分割会在每一步都按光栅读取顺序重新为组件编号，在棋盘上移动的动态实体会不断交换编号，导致合成的 Python 脚本悄然引用错误的对象。 为了保持时序一致性，Sarbloh 将对象标识符锚定在每个关卡的初始帧上，并通过多阶段二部图匹配算法在转换过程中保持身份不变。 该流程按顺序执行五个阶段：颜色、形状和位置均未改变的对象；颜色和形状相同但发生移动的对象（取最近者）；形状和位置相同但被重新着色的对象；颜色相同但形状改变的对象（取共享单元格最多者）；最后，为未匹配到任何对象的新对象分配新的标识符（算法 1，阶段 1）。 因此，每个标识符都能在整个关卡中可靠地追踪同一个物理实体。 除了被追踪的对象表之外，空间状态还被序列化为字母数字坐标网格，并与一个差分变化账本配对，详细记录每次转换所修改的边界框和单元格数量。 此外，发生在三格屏幕外围边界内的环境修改被隔离为抬头显示遥测数据，防止被动的计数器递减或计时器跳动被误判为操作性任务进展。

sents.en: The engine first splits the frame into terrain —colours that cover more than 8% of the frame—and things (corridors, edge gauges, multi-colour assemblies joined by union-find over 8-connected components, panel icons and dotted figures).
sents.zh: 引擎首先把帧切分为地形——覆盖帧面积超过8%的颜色——以及各种物体（走廊、边缘标尺、通过基于8连通分量的并查集连接的多色组合、面板图标和点状图形）。

sents.en: It then computes seven kinds of measured fact:
sents.zh: 然后，它会计算七种测量型事实：

paragraphs.en: Reachability : breadth-first search over the detected lattice —the tile grid the player moves on—gives step counts from the likely agent to every target (“ obj 6: reachable in 6 steps ”).
paragraphs.zh: 可达性：对检测到的点阵——即玩家移动的瓦片网格——进行广度优先搜索，可得到从可能的智能体到每个目标的步数（“ obj 6：可在 6 步内到达 ”）。

paragraphs.en: Enclosure : closed outlines around empty space, matched against objects of the same size.
paragraphs.zh: 围合：围绕空白空间的闭合轮廓，与相同大小的物体进行匹配。

paragraphs.en: Midpoint tethers : an object held at the midpoint of two others by thin lines, so moving one end moves it (“ obj 25 held at midpoint of obj 16 and 36 ”).
paragraphs.zh: 中点系绳：一个物体通过细线固定在另两个物体的中点，因此移动一端即可移动它（“物体25固定在物体16和36的中点”）。

paragraphs.en: Alignment : shared rows or columns between objects.
paragraphs.zh: 对齐：对象之间共享的行或列。

paragraphs.en: Dihedral symmetry : equality of two shapes under the eight rotations and mirrorings of the square and integer scaling ( D 4 × ℤ + D_{4}\times\mathbb{Z}^{+} ), as in “ obj 12 (drawn 2x bigger), mirrored left-right OR turned 90 deg clockwise, becomes exactly obj 4 ”.
paragraphs.zh: 二面体对称：两个形状在正方形的八种旋转与镜像以及整数缩放（ D 4 × ℤ + D_{4}\times\mathbb{Z}^{+} ）下等价，例如“ obj 12 （画得大 2 倍），左右镜像或顺时针旋转 90 度后，恰好变成 obj 4 ”。

paragraphs.en: Copies : identical shapes counted as a set (lives, items).
paragraphs.zh: 份数：被视为一组的相同形状（生命、道具）。

paragraphs.en: Lopsided colouring : a symmetric shape with asymmetric colours, which usually marks a direction or a state.
paragraphs.zh: 不对称着色：一种形状对称但颜色不对称的设计，通常用于标记某个方向或状态。

paragraphs.en: Because pairwise geometric relations like coordinate alignments expand combinatorially in dense scenes (e.g., 792 alignment pairs in bp35 ), an unweighted global line cap allows high-frequency alignments to crowd out vital invariants such as symmetries and affordance hypotheses. paragraphs.zh: 由于在密集场景中，像坐标对齐这样的成对几何关系会呈组合级增长（例如 bp35 中有 792 个对齐对），不加权重的全局行数上限会让高频对齐挤占诸如对称性和可供性假设等重要不变量。 为保持结构平衡，简报调度器在各不变量类别之间按比例分配行数配额，并为候选角色假设保留至多三分之一的显示空间，将多余的关系汇总为聚合计数而不是直接截断（详见附录 C）。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 2 defines the execution contract between the planned trajectory and the environment, specifying the exact conditions that govern path termination. An inaccurate state prediction does not interrupt execution. Instead, play() logs the first action whose predicted state differs from the true grid outside the HUD, records the mismatched coordinates, and continues along the trajectory. The path halts only when a level or game terminates, when consecutive identical actions collide with an obstacle without altering a single pixel, or when the revisit guard identifies a board state already visited during the current attempt. The loop never stalls to verify an operational rule, ensuring that any inaccuracies in the internal world model are resolved immediately upon receiving the next frame. Two of the stops are switches. The revisit guard was off in Run B (briefing on), and the replay guard, which refuses before any move a path that repeats a lost try move for move from the same first board, was on; the saved configuration of Run A (briefing off) records neither switch.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 2 定义了规划轨迹与环境之间的执行契约，明确了控制路径终止的确切条件。 不准确的状态预测不会中断执行。 相反，play() 会在 HUD 之外记录第一个预测状态与真实网格不一致的动作，记录不匹配的坐标，并沿轨迹继续执行。 只有在关卡或游戏结束时、连续相同的动作碰撞到障碍物而没有改变任何像素时、或重访保护机制识别出棋盘状态在当前尝试中已被访问过时，路径才会停止。 循环从不停顿去验证操作规则，从而确保内部世界模型中的任何不准确之处都能在接收到下一帧时立即得到解决。 其中两个停止条件是开关。 重访保护在运行 B（简报开启）中是关闭的，而回放保护（在任何移动之前拒绝一条从相同初始棋盘开始、逐动作重复某次失败尝试的路径）是开启的；运行 A（简报关闭）保存的配置中两个开关都没有记录。

paragraphs.en: The revisit guard terminates path execution whenever the non-HUD board configuration repeats a state encountered earlier in the attempt. In counterfactual analysis over 9,913 actions, the guard identified 2,331 duplicate states (with a minor false-positive cost of 6 winning transitions). Under live deployment, when interrupted by the guard, reasoning models compensated by increasing single-action invocations from 8.9% to 17.8% and dispatching subsequent moves in the same cell, shifting completed levels marginally from 50 to 52 out of 97. We retain the guard as a configurable safeguard while noting that visible execution constraints can induce compensatory behaviors in reasoning backbones.
paragraphs.zh: 当非HUD棋盘配置重复了本次尝试中较早出现过的状态时，重访守卫会终止路径执行。 在对9,913个动作的反事实分析中，该守卫识别出2,331个重复状态（伴随6个获胜转移的轻微误报代价）。 在实际部署中，当被该守卫中断时，推理模型通过将单动作调用比例从8.9%提高到17.8%并在同一格子中分派后续移动来进行补偿，使完成关卡数从97关中的50关小幅提升至52关。 我们保留该守卫作为可配置的安全保障，同时指出可见的执行约束会在推理主干中诱发补偿性行为。

paragraphs.en: We deploy our 125B MoE backbone quantized to W4A16 using AutoRound ( Cheng et al. 2023 ) and served via SGLang ( Zheng et al. 2023 ) with EAGLE speculative decoding ( Li et al. 2024 ) . The model architecture mixes Gated DeltaNet linear-recurrent layers with attention ( Yang et al. 2024 ) . Its recurrent state cannot be rewound, so the server can resume only from the state saved at the end of an earlier request, and the prefix cache matches nothing past the first modified token. To guarantee cache reuse, we enforce an append-only invariant: every request is the previous request plus its reply and new messages, word for word. Visual maps are retained across turns, reasoning remains in history, and working memory updates append as new lines. A game retains its GPU slot for 20 requests before scheduling handoff. Across our full benchmark run, 98.4% of 1.78 B prompt tokens were served directly from cache, reducing prefill to 1.3% of busy time and rendering execution decode-bound (Figure 6 ).

paragraphs.en: Harnesses that compact context typically invoke an LLM to generate summaries ( Knutsen and Klein 2026 ) , which costs shared GPU cycles and risks hallucinating persistent false facts into context history. Our context drain operates entirely without model inference: when context exceeds 118k tokens, it deterministically drops the oldest complete turns until history falls below 55k tokens. paragraphs.en: The agent maintains four level-keyed symbolic dictionaries in the Python kernel ( GOAL , PLAN , HYPOTHESES , FINDINGS ) that persist across context drains and level transitions. Upon level completion, a curator call consolidates confirmed mechanics into a persistent SKILLS repository and registers refuted rules to prevent redundant exploration. Across 25 concurrent games, an asynchronous priority scheduler allocates 10 active GPU slots based on level reward weight discounted by committed actions, multiplying by a decay factor that prevents stalled games from starving progressing ones (Appendix A ).

paragraphs.en: Across our development cycle, several architectural alternatives proved detrimental or inert. Replacing past code with semantic stubs caused 6B models to degenerate into copying comment templates in 97.7% of calls, fine-tuning on self-generated successful traces reduced training loss while degrading interactive generalization, and spawning autonomous subagents introduced coordination overhead without performance gain. A complete analysis of these ablated designs and runtime edge cases is provided in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 在整个开发周期中，若干架构方案被证明是有害或无效的。 用语义占位桩替换过去的代码导致 6B 模型在 97.7% 的调用中退化为照抄注释模板；在智能体自生成的成功轨迹上进行微调虽然降低了训练损失，却损害了交互泛化能力；而派生自主子智能体则引入了协调开销，却未带来性能提升。 关于这些消融设计与运行时边界情况的完整分析见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate how alternative state representations influence visual scene comprehension, we designed a controlled perception lab evaluating nine distinct presentation formats on the opening frames of ls20 (discrete arrow-key navigation) and r11l (continuous coordinate click interactions). Each presentation was graded against a pre-registered 28-point rubric measuring seven essential perceptual dimensions: agent identification, goal state, mechanical links, hazards, status gauges, terrain composition, and winning plan induction. As detailed in Table 3 and Figure 7 , our initial baseline (the Legacy Encoder, arc_eye ) scored only 3 of 28 points despite consuming 3,500 text tokens per frame. Because it serialized coordinates without relational synthesis, the reasoning model bore the entire burden of deducing spatial semantics, misclassifying functional move gauges as inert screen chrome.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估不同的状态表示方式如何影响视觉场景理解，我们设计了一个受控感知实验室，在 ls20（离散方向键导航）和 r11l（连续坐标点击交互）的开局帧上评估九种不同的呈现格式。 每种呈现格式都按照一份预先注册的 28 分评分细则进行评分，该细则衡量七个关键感知维度：智能体识别、目标状态、机械连接、危险物、状态仪表、地形构成以及获胜策略推断。 如表 3 和图 7 所示，我们的初始基线（传统编码器，arc_eye）尽管每帧消耗 3,500 个文本 token，却仅获得 28 分中的 3 分。 由于它只是序列化坐标而缺乏关系综合，推理模型不得不独自承担推断空间语义的全部负担，将具有功能的移动仪表误判为无用的屏幕装饰元素。

paragraphs.en: Representational interventions advanced comprehension across two distinct axes. First, host-side geometric computations (X3 Visual Routines and X4 Look-alike Threads) extracted spatial properties that neural vision encoders fail to resolve reliably, such as discovering midpoint tethers and identifying that the ls20 inventory icon matches the goal glyph rotated by 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} and rescaled. Second, candidate role annotations (X7 Role Ledger) provided rapid operational context, raising the rubric score to 20/28. Synthesizing these approaches into the Fused Briefing (X8) achieved 25 of 28 points at 370 tokens per frame, representing an 8.3 × 8.3\times score improvement over the baseline alongside an 89.4% reduction in token consumption. Dumping raw 64 × 64 64\times 64 ASCII grids alongside per-cell component tables forces the tokenizer to spend ≈ 3,500 \approx 3{,}500 tokens per frame encoding repetitive background coordinates; by abstracting connected components on the host, moving spatial layout into the visual Blueprint raster, and emitting only non-redundant geometric relations in text, the Fused Briefing compresses prompt footprint by 89.4% (to 370 tokens) while increasing prefix-cache capacity by 9.5 × 9.5\times .
paragraphs.zh: 表征干预在两个不同的维度上提升了理解能力。 首先，主机侧的几何计算（X3 Visual Routines 与 X4 Look-alike Threads）提取了神经视觉编码器难以可靠解析的空间属性，例如发现中点连接关系，以及识别出 ls20 物品栏图标与旋转 90 度并重新缩放后的目标图形相匹配。 其次，候选角色标注（X7 Role Ledger）提供了快速的操作上下文，将评分量规得分提升至 20/28。 将这些方法融合到 Fused Briefing（X8）后，在每帧 370 个 token 的条件下取得了 28 分中的 25 分，相比基线实现了 8.3 倍的得分提升，同时 token 消耗减少了 89.4%。 直接输出原始的 64×64 ASCII 网格以及逐单元格的组件表，会迫使分词器每帧花费约 3,500 个 token 来编码重复的背景坐标；通过在主机侧抽象连通组件、将空间布局移入视觉 Blueprint 栅格图，并在文本中只输出非冗余的几何关系，Fused Briefing 将提示占用压缩了 89.4%（降至 370 个 token），同时将前缀缓存容量提升了 9.5 倍。

paragraphs.en: We decomposed the 40.6 total points lost from a perfect benchmark score using official RHAE weighting (Figure 8 b). paragraphs.en: To isolate algorithmic contributions from compute resources, we evaluated Sarbloh directly against the first Milestone winner (the Duck harness ( Tufa Labs 2026 ) ) on identical Kaggle hardware (one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000) and identical Qwen3.8-Flash-Next model weights. While the baseline ran four parallel passes per game (100 concurrent streams), Sarbloh executed a single scheduled pass across the 25 public games. Crucially, this is Run A, which ran with the briefing and map disabled and characterizes the action interface, serving loop, and scheduler (Appendix C.4 ); in contrast, the official hidden-set score of 16.53 was produced with the full perception engine active (Figure 9 ). As shown in Figure 10 , Sarbloh consistently accelerated discovery, clearing 73 levels versus 54 at one hour, 97 versus 63 at two hours, and finishing at 143 of 183 levels in 8.2 hours versus 129 distinct levels for the baseline. This efficiency stems from our priority scheduler concentrating compute on game states with high marginal progress potential rather than partitioning resources uniformly.

paragraphs.en: A critical distinction governs the comparison between offline competition submissions and frontier API benchmarks. Systems reporting near-ceiling scores on public games (Prime Agent, AVO, Arcgentica) operate across commercial API endpoints with unbounded wall-clock time, unrestricted internet access, and proprietary closed-weight backbones such as Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol. Furthermore, these evaluations execute on disclosed, publicly accessible environments where prompt templates and heuristic search budgets can be manually adapted without verifiable submission constraints. In contrast, Sarbloh operates within the official competition environment, where an immutable Docker container executes on a single offline GPU without external network access, constrained by a strict nine-hour wall-clock ceiling across the entire benchmark suite of undisclosed games. In this hardware-bounded regime, where every exploratory misstep incurs non-linear score degradation, achieving an official score of 16.53 represents an unprecedented result that surpasses the first Milestone winner by 13.7 × 13.7\times , establishing that structured core-knowledge perception enables open-weight models to compete effectively without requiring unconstrained cloud resources.

paragraphs.en: On public environments, Sarbloh achieves an aggregate mean score of 72.5 across evaluation trials, outperforming proprietary frontier models evaluated via unconstrained APIs on 21 of 25 games and achieving 100% resolution on 13 games (Figure 1 ). Under a single-pass regime, Sarbloh recorded a mean score of 59.4 in Run A, briefing off (Table 7 ), and 63.5 in Run B, briefing on (Table 8 ), each exceeding the strongest frontier baseline (GPT-6.1 Sol at 54.8). paragraphs.en: Prior ARC-AGI-3 architectures differ across planning strategies, context memory management, and external tooling, yet they share a uniform perceptual assumption: the visual grid is transmitted directly to the reasoning model as raw unparsed data, delegating spatial scene decomposition entirely to neural inference (Table 1 ). Specifically, the first Milestone winner (the Duck harness ( Tufa Labs 2026 ; ARC Prize Foundation 2026a ) ) serializes the board as composite ASCII character matrices alongside rendered image frames. The second- and third-place Kaggle systems pass annotated screenshots to Gemma-4-31B, prompting the vision model to emit JSON action sequences directly ( ARC Prize Foundation 2026a ) . In the frontier API regime, VISTA ( Han et al. 2026 ) deploys a multimodal harness with lossless visual frame retention, while Arcgentica ( Knutsen and Klein 2026 ) and Prime Agent ( Karten et al. 2026 ) expose the environment within a persistent Python REPL, leaving the language model to write its own parsing scripts over raw coordinate arrays.

paragraphs.en: Across all existing systems, the agent observes the world as an integer matrix, an ASCII string, or an unannotated visual raster. Consequently, fundamental spatial primitives, including 4-connected entity segmentation, topological containment, lattice-constrained reachability, and affine symmetries, are left to be reconstructed by the neural backbone from raw tokens. As our motivating ablations establish (Section 3 ), this unparsed representation forms the primary source of action inefficiency and hallucination. In contrast, Sarbloh computes geometric invariants deterministically on the host in 𝒪 ⁡ ( H ​ W ) \mathcal{O}(HW) time, maintains persistent bipartite entity tracking across temporal steps, and explicitly decouples mathematical certainties from single-action testable affordance hypotheses.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有现有系统中，智能体观察世界的方式是整数矩阵、ASCII 字符串或未经标注的视觉栅格。 因此，基础的空间原语——包括 4 连通实体分割、拓扑包含关系、受格点约束的可达性以及仿射对称性——都留待神经骨干网络从原始词元中重新构建。 正如我们的动机性消融实验所证明的（第 3 节），这种未经解析的表示是动作低效率与幻觉的主要来源。 相比之下，Sarbloh 在宿主端以 𝒪(HW) 时间确定性地计算几何不变量，在时间步之间维护持久的二部图实体跟踪，并将数学上的确定性显式地与单动作可测试的可供性假设解耦。

paragraphs.en: The CodeAct paradigm ( Wang et al. 2024 ) demonstrated that expressing agent actions through executable programming primitives outperforms specialized JSON action schemas. Prime Agent ( Karten et al. 2026 ) adapted this to ARC-AGI-3 by allowing models to execute Python code within an interactive environment. However, earlier harnesses decoupled model reasoning into disjoint tools for code simulation and action execution, forcing expensive context-switching roundtrips. Sarbloh unifies these operations within an asynchronous execution contract ( await play() ), allowing models to hypothesize, simulate, and commit multi-step actuation trajectories within a single reasoning turn.
paragraphs.zh: CodeAct 范式（Wang et al. 2024）证明了通过可执行的编程原语来表达智能体动作，优于专门的 JSON 动作模式。 Prime Agent（Karten et al. 2026）将其适配到 ARC-AGI-3，允许模型在交互式环境中执行 Python 代码。 然而，早期的框架将模型推理解耦为彼此独立的代码模拟与动作执行工具，迫使代价高昂的上下文切换往返。 Sarbloh 在一个异步执行契约（await play()）中统一了这些操作，使模型能够在单个推理回合内进行假设、模拟并提交多步驱动轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Several architectural limitations remain. First, while affordance hypotheses are coupled with unit falsification tests, the current perception engine evaluates hypotheses independently at each frame without maintaining a fully unified Bayesian belief distribution across multi-step episodes. Second, although the agent plans with super-human efficiency once a level is understood, antecedent failure on complex perceptual transitions remains the primary source of score degradation. Finally, our current results rely on general-purpose open-weight models without task-specific policy fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 仍存在若干架构上的局限。 首先，尽管可供性假设与单元证伪测试相耦合，当前的感知引擎在每一帧独立评估假设，而未在多步回合中维护一个完全统一的贝叶斯信念分布。 其次，虽然该智能体在关卡被理解后能以超越人类的效率进行规划，但在复杂感知转换上的先导失败仍是得分下降的主要来源。 最后，我们目前的结果依赖于通用开源权重模型，而未进行任务特定的策略微调。

paragraphs.en: Closed-Loop Belief Updating : Formulating affordance induction as a dynamic partially observable belief state, where the empirical outcomes of unit falsification probes explicitly update prior belief weights across compositional levels.
paragraphs.zh: 闭环信念更新：将可供性归纳建模为一个动态的部分可观测信念状态，其中单元证伪探针的经验结果显式地更新跨组合层级的先验信念权重。

paragraphs.en: Offline Trajectory Fine-Tuning : Applying parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA ( Hu et al. 2021 ) ) directly on our database of verified, high-efficiency execution trajectories, optimizing syntactic code generation and world model synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 离线轨迹微调：直接在我们已验证的高效执行轨迹数据库上应用参数高效微调（LoRA（Hu et al. 2021）），优化句法代码生成与世界模型合成。

paragraphs.en: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning : Investigating offline reinforcement learning algorithms, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO ( Shao et al. 2024 ) ) and balanced policy clipping, to optimize planning depth and action parsimony within our fixed computational envelope.
paragraphs.zh: 样本高效强化学习：研究离线强化学习算法，例如群体相对策略优化（GRPO（Shao et al. 2024））和平衡策略裁剪，以在我们的固定计算包络内优化规划深度与动作简约性。

paragraphs.en: Autonomous reasoning in uninstructed interactive environments is fundamentally constrained by perception rather than downstream algorithmic planning. Under the non-linear action penalties of ARC-AGI-3, agents cannot afford to compensate for impoverished representations through exploratory trial and error. As our empirical investigations demonstrate, presenting environments as unparsed coordinate matrices induces perceptual misinduction, compelling language and vision backbones to squander their action budgets attempting to reconstruct topological adjacency and basic spatial mechanics.
paragraphs.zh: 在无指令的交互环境中，自主推理从根本上受制于感知，而非下游的算法规划。 在 ARC-AGI-3 的非线性动作惩罚机制下，智能体无法通过探索性的试错来弥补表征的贫乏。 正如我们的实证研究所示，将环境呈现为未解析的坐标矩阵会诱发感知误导，迫使语言与视觉主干模型为重建拓扑邻接关系和基础空间力学而浪费其动作预算。

paragraphs.en: To resolve this limitation, we introduced Sarbloh , an autonomous agent architecture organized around the Measured–Guessed Rule. By computing deterministic geometric invariants directly on the host in linear time, the perception engine extracts lattice reachability, topological enclosures, midpoint tethers, and dihedral symmetries as mathematical certainties that generalize unconditionally across novel environments. Simultaneously, the framework treats latent operational semantics not as brittle classifications, but as provisional inductive hypotheses paired with minimal unit-action verification probes. Grounded by this perceptual foundation, the agent models environment transitions through programmatic Python execution, dispatching multi-step actuation trajectories that halt dynamically upon encountering unexpected state transitions.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这一局限，我们提出了 Sarbloh，一种围绕「度量—猜测规则」组织起来的自主智能体架构。 通过在宿主上以线性时间直接计算确定性的几何不变量，感知引擎将晶格可达性、拓扑包围、中点系留和二面对称性提取为数学上的确定性结论，这些结论可无条件地泛化到新环境中。 与此同时，该框架并不将潜在的操作语义视为脆弱的分类结果，而是将其视为与最小单元动作验证探针配对的临时归纳假设。 以这一感知基础为依托，智能体通过程序化的 Python 执行来建模环境转移，并调度多步执行轨迹，一旦遇到意外的状态转移便动态停止。

paragraphs.en: Our findings indicate that advancing fluid intelligence on novel benchmarks does not strictly necessitate larger parameter scales or unconstrained inference budgets. paragraphs.en: Executes serial geometric routines based on Ullman (1984) . Reach performs breadth-first search across detected lattice steps, reporting path lengths from the likely agent to all visible targets. paragraphs.en: Figures 13 – 16 repeat Figure 5 for the opening frames of ka59 , m0r0 , r11l and sb26 . They were made in the same way: make_perception_figure.py runs the agent’s perception code on the first frame of each local game, and panels (b) and (c) are drawn from its object table and briefing. Each line in (c) stands for one MEASURED line of the briefing in (e). Where an object is made of one-cell parts (the dotted ring and the connecting lines in r11l ) or repeats (the four grey squares in sb26 ), the parts are outlined and the group gets one tag. paragraphs.en: In early iterations, the host-side lattice detection module fitted tile dimensions over all non-terrain pixels. In ls20 , when the player moved, an off-grid gauge within the status box introduced irregular coordinate intervals, causing the fitted 5 × 5 5{\times}5 grid to collapse. Similarly, in ka59 , touching a secondary sprite altered the detected lattice periodicity. Each collapse temporarily deleted all reachability invariants from context, causing the agent to vacillate between conflicting spatial hypotheses. We resolved this by explicitly excluding peripheral HUD regions from the lattice fitting routine and caching the initial valid lattice configuration for the remainder of the level.
paragraphs.zh: 在早期迭代中，宿主端的网格检测模块对所有非地形像素拟合瓦片尺寸。 在 ls20 中，当玩家移动时，状态框内偏离网格的仪表引入了不规则的坐标间隔，导致拟合出的 5 × 5 5{\times}5 网格崩溃。 类似地，在 ka59 中，触碰次要精灵会改变检测到的网格周期性。 每次崩溃都会临时删除上下文中的所有可达性不变量，导致智能体在相互冲突的空间假设之间摇摆不定。 我们通过在网格拟合例程中显式排除边缘 HUD 区域，并缓存初始有效网格配置以供该关卡后续使用，解决了这一问题。

paragraphs.en: Transmitting only differential coordinate changes between frames substantially reduces prompt token consumption. However, in ARC-AGI-3 environments where local actions trigger distant causal effects (e.g., activating a floor plate updating an icon across the display), sparse updates conceal non-local covariance. In development traces, models receiving delta updates consistently concluded that actions were non-functional when localized pixels remained static, leading to catastrophic action loops. Full-frame visual representations remain essential for maintaining causal coherence.
paragraphs.zh: 仅在帧间传输差分坐标变化可显著减少提示词 token 消耗。 然而，在 ARC-AGI-3 环境中，局部动作会触发远处的因果效应（例如，激活一块地板板会更新整个显示器上的图标），稀疏更新掩盖了非局部的协变性。 在开发轨迹中，接收到增量更新的模型在局部像素保持静止时，一致地得出动作无功能的结论，从而导致灾难性的动作循环。 全帧视觉表示对于维持因果一致性仍然至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Providing separate tool interfaces for code execution and environment stepping caused models to fragment reasoning trajectories. The agent formulated world models in code, exited the REPL to dispatch individual actions, and re-entered code execution to reconstruct state variables, multiplying inference latency. Merging action commitment directly into the Python kernel via await play() was the single intervention responsible for advancing the hidden-set score from 5.14 to 5.65.
paragraphs.zh: 为代码执行和环境步进提供分开的工具接口，导致模型将推理轨迹碎片化。 智能体在代码中构建世界模型，然后退出 REPL 以分发单个动作，再重新进入代码执行来重建状态变量，从而成倍增加了推理延迟。 通过 await play() 将动作承诺直接合并进 Python 内核，是使隐藏测试集得分从 5.14 提升到 5.65 的唯一关键干预措施。

sents.zh: 为代码执行和环境步进提供分开的工具接口，导致模型将推理轨迹碎片化。

paragraphs.en: To conserve context window capacity, we tested replacing executed historical code cells with brief descriptive comments. In the two test runs that had stubbing switched on, reasoning backbones degenerated into copying comment strings rather than generating executable Python code (occurring in 97.7% of turns and clearing 0 of 97 levels). Smaller open-weight models heavily imitate local context formatting; historical code must remain intact as functional syntax.
paragraphs.zh: 为了节省上下文窗口容量，我们测试了用简短的描述性注释替换已执行的历史代码单元格。 在开启存根替换的两次测试运行中，推理主干退化为复制注释字符串而非生成可执行的 Python 代码（出现在 97.7% 的轮次中，97 个关卡无一通过）。 较小的开源权重模型会严重模仿局部上下文的格式；历史代码必须保持完整以作为功能性语法。

paragraphs.en: Providing the model with programmatic subagent delegation primitives (following the Prime Agent specification) yielded zero productive invocations across all benchmark runs. paragraphs.en: We fine-tuned Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on successful execution traces using low-rank adaptation (LoRA). While training cross-entropy loss decreased from 11% to 6%, out-of-distribution benchmark performance degraded significantly. The fine-tuned weights exhibited rigid memorization of specific coordinate paths rather than generalized spatial reasoning, consuming over 80% of our training compute budget without positive yield.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用低秩适应（LoRA）在成功执行轨迹上对 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 进行了微调。 虽然训练交叉熵损失从 11% 降至 6%，但分布外基准测试的性能显著下降。 微调后的权重表现出对特定坐标路径的僵硬记忆，而非泛化的空间推理能力，消耗了我们超过 80% 的训练算力预算却没有带来正向收益。

paragraphs.en: In Run A (briefing off), four games ( lf52 , s5i5 , vc33 , re86 ) stopped 2 to 15 actions short of their 2,000-action cap. The harness kept asking them to continue, and the model answered “ Holding... ” about 14,000 times, which used 1.24 B of the run’s 1.78 B prompt tokens. The stalls began after these games had cleared every level they would clear, so they cost wall clock, not score. The harness has a per-game turn limit (400 by default), but both full runs set it to 10 6 10^{6} , so no run reported here was protected by it; whether the limit removes the stall without costing levels is untested.

paragraphs.en: Run B had the briefing and map on, together with new guardrails and a stuck-level review, and ran for 5.4 h (Table 8 ).
